question: If 2 x-(1)/(x)=3,xne0, then simplify 8x⁶ - 25x³ - 1.
solution:
**Given:**

2 x-(1)/(x)=3

**Concept used:**

if a - 1/a = b

Then,

a³ - 1/a³ = (b)³ + 3b

**Calculation:**

2x - 1/x = 3

⇒ (2x)³ - (1/x)³ - 3 × 2 × 3 = 3³

⇒ 8x3 - 1/x3 = 27 + 6 × 3

⇒ 8x3 - 1/x3 = 27 + 18

⇒ 8x3 - 1/x3 = 45

By multiplying both sides with x³ we get,

8x⁶ - 1 = 45x³

Now,

By subtracting both side by 25x³ we get,

8x6 - 25x3 - 1 = 45x³ - 25x³

⇒ 20x³

**∴ Required answer is 20x3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

(a – 1/a) = b

On cubing both sides we'll get,

(a – 1/a)3 = b3 

⇒ a3 – (1/a)3 – 3(a)(1/a)(a – 1/a) = b3 

⇒ a3 – (1/a)3 – 3(a – 1/a) = b3 

⇒ a3 – (1/a)3 – 3(b) = b3 

⇒ a3 – (1/a)3 = b3 + 3(b)
